question.text: Which of the following entities is covered under Section 23E of SCRA for penalty on failure to comply with listing conditions?

answer.text: A company or any person managing a collective investment scheme, mutual fund, REIT, InvIT, or AIF
Only stock exchanges and clearing corporations

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 23E covers a company or any person managing a collective investment scheme, mutual fund, REIT, InvIT, or AIF that fails to comply with listing or delisting conditions. The Trap: Limiting it to only listed companies ignores the wider scope, which extends to persons managing CIS, MFs, REITs, InvITs, and AIFs (not just the schemes themselves). Note: Section 23E penalises the company or the person managing the scheme/fund, not the scheme/fund as a standalone entity.
